Karthik — confirmed: our most recent SOC 2 Type II report is a period-based report covering 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, issued 2026-02-10. The PDF we provide is the full audited report for that period.

Regarding procurement acceptance: if their policy requires proof of coverage through 2025-12-31, the issued report satisfies that. If the portal flags "expired" because it looks for a report issued within a rolling 12 months, we can supply a one-page attestation (signed) stating: "No material changes to control environment between 2026-01-01 and [current date]" — this is typically accepted in lieu of a formal bridge letter. We avoid calling it a "bridge letter" unless the auditor issues an official bridge; instead we provide a compliance attestation & the audit appendix that lists scope and control exceptions (if any).

Suggested attestation text (short form):

"Redwood Inference attests that there have been no material changes to the design or operation of the controls included in the SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 as of the date of this attestation (2026-05-20)."

I can package the issued PDF and a one-page attestation (signed) for procurement. I’ve attached the Audit Appendix extract (SOC2_Audit_Appendix_2025.xlsx) for their review — it shows the control scope, subservice providers, and testing exceptions.

Dylan, flag if you want a fuller note or different wording.
